audit_items.proof_trace: `mint_ctokens` computes `mint_amount = float::int_div(collateral_amount, self.exchange_rate())` using the pre-deposit exchange rate; `int_div(b, a)` = `WAD * b / a.value` is exact floor division, so `mint_amount == floor(amt / exchangeRate)`. `increase_ctoken_supply` then does `self.total_supply = self.total_supply + amount` unconditionally, so `total_supply_post == total_supply_pre + floor(amt / exchangeRate)` holds exactly. u64 overflow would abort (Move checked arithmetic), and no concurrent mutation is possible on Sui.
